title: Basic Polyhedral Theory
author: Volker Kaibel

theorems.8: Finite convex-plus-conic representation; rational input admits rational generators.
theorems.10: The conic part equals the recession cone.
theorems.20: Integer points of a rational polyhedron equal a finite integer base set plus a finitely generated integer monoid.

application_check: Strict integer signs become weak bounds by1; parity splits into affine residue substitutions; direct fractional-coefficient remainder proof handles lineality with both signed generators.
